Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package.
If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(tsacl completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	tsacl completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/tsacl

#### macOS:

	tsacl completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/tsacl

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

Every visible, runnable command becomes a tool, except the reserved __schema, mcp-server, completion, and help commands and any command excluded with mcp.Exclude; tools/call runs the command in machine mode and returns its payload. --dir compiles every file named acl.json, acl.hujson, *.acl.json or *.acl.hujson in the
given directories into standard JSON (comments are stripped). --base and --add deep-merge
one snippet into a base policy, keeping the base's HuJSON comments and the comments on keys the
snippet adds.
